mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, IFNULL(SUM(enterprise_type = 1), 0) AS fishing_count, IFNULL(SUM(enterprise_type = 2), 0) AS processing_count, IFNULL(SUM(enterprise_type = 3), 0) AS wholesale_count, IFNULL(SUM(enterprise_type = 4), 0) AS retail_count, COUNT(DISTINCT province_code) AS province_count, IFNULL(SUM(DATE(register_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS today_register_count FROM node_enterprise WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM node_enterprise WHERE deleted = 0 AND register_time >= #{startMonth} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT province_code, province_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM node_enterprise WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY province_code, province_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, province_code ASC

SELECT e.enterprise_type AS enterprise_type, d.item_value AS enterprise_type_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM node_enterprise e LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item d ON d.type_code = 'enterprise_type' AND d.item_code = CAST(e.enterprise_type AS CHAR) WHERE e.deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.enterprise_type, d.item_value ORDER BY e.enterprise_type ASC
